name: epileptic
description: Epileptic application component of the Communications Platform MVP. Realises the Communication Service (epileptic.com) and provides the Content Management function over the Content Data Object.

scripts.start: d="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$d/go.mod" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; cd "$d" && exec mise exec -- go run .
